title: Stoker’s Wintergreen Tub 12oz Long Cut
description:
Stoker’s Wintergreen Tub 12oz Long Cut

Stoker’s Wintergreen Tub 12oz Long Cut is a snuff product based on long cut tobacco. The fact that the tobacco is long makes it easier pack and pinch, while staying together better in your mouth. Stoker’s Straight Tubs 12oz Long is manufacture by National Tobacco Company and has a natural tobacco flavor with hints of wintergreen. The nicotine strength is 2 on a 5-grade scale, placing it within the “normal” range compared to similar snuff and dip products. Snuff and dip can also be experience in fine and loose ground. You can find more classic chewing tobacco on the Shoal brand page. One tub equals 10 cans.
